question:
Match the following personalities with their associated musical instrument:

 
 

 
 
(A)

 
 
 
S. Balachander

 
 
 
1

 
 
 
Tabla

 
 
 

 
 
(B)

 
 
 
Anushka Shankar

 
 
 
2

 
 
 
Veena

 
 
 

 
 
(C)

 
 
 
Kishan Maharaj

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
Sitar
solution:
The correct answer is __**4)A - 2, B - 3, C - 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **S. Balachander** is associated with the **Veena**.
 
• **Anushka Shankar** is associated with the **Sitar**.
 
• **Kishan Maharaj** is associated with the **Tabla**.
 
• Thus, the correct matching is **A - 2, B - 3, C - 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Veena** is a traditional Indian string instrument.
 
• The **Sitar** is a plucked stringed instrument used in Indian classical music.
 
• The **Tabla** is a pair of twin hand drums from the Indian subcontinent, used in traditional, classical, popular, and folk music.
